title: Step-5 competition phase controller and replay
summary: Native ooRexx game controller on the unchanged qualified referee, stub games and replay. Five phases/year, ownership after Fall retreats, solo or year limit.
invariants: Use DiplomacyGameConfig~load(data/game.conf), DiplomacyGame~new(board, judge, config, initialUnits, initialOwnership, source, journal, seed). The existing referee and its rules.conf are unchanged.

Movement calls one per surviving power, retreat calls only for dislodged powers, winter calls only for nonzero adjustment quota. Detached public board, map, ownership, own task and last results; no opposing current submissions, legal-order list or referee reference.
Source returns (status, array of raw order lines). Bad response, exception or timeout status gives no orders. Real timeout implementation remains step 7.

LogService v0.7 emits immutable canonical event payloads to an INTERNAL journal target. All calls (including empty/failed), raw bytes, states, outcomes, ownership, automatic removals and year tallies logged. Log includes map, rules, referee version, seed. Wall clock and process identifiers excluded from replay projection.
ReplaySource consumes recorded calls only; re-adjudicate and compare complete bytes. A syntax failure is logged, must stop the game; failed or incomplete journal cannot replay as completed.
Hold/random stubs are qualification sources, not competitive prompts. One local Park-Miller PRNG in random stub. No live API calls.
procedure: Set REXX_PATH to src, tools, estate packages/oorexx_logging_v0.7/src; native r13196.
rexx tools/game.rex run HOLD 7 hold.log; rexx tools/game.rex replay hold.log hold-replay.log
rexx tools/game.rex run RANDOM 20261126 random.log; rexx tools/game.rex replay random.log random-replay.log
sh tests/run.sh with ALCHEMY_REPO_ROOT; all referee regression tests and game stage tests.

evidence.scope: step-5 game controller; existing referee and rules unchanged

directed_tests: Retreat calls only for dislodged powers; Fall ownership changes after retreats; two winter builds; replay exact.
Solo at 18 after Fall retreats, no winter phase.
Bad response, reported timeout and source exception give no orders atomically; raw bytes preserved.
Detached task mutation cannot alter later calls or referee state.
Injected judge failure stops game and logs error without publishing failed phase result; missing/failed/tampered journal rejected.
